hero.subtitle: A Mirigama-based spare parts shop, serving customers island-wide.

story.heading: Our Story
paragraphs: Mudiyanse Auto Solutions is a vehicle spare parts shop based in Mirigama, Sri Lanka. We supply parts for three-wheelers, bikes, cars, SUVs and more, to customers across the island.
Every order is checked before it leaves our shop, and we deliver island-wide with Cash on Delivery.
